positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Specializing in Python, building and maintaining distributed workflows that populate bond level data feeding into the Bloomberg Barclays Indices. Occasional work in C++ microservices and Javascript-based UI.
positions.insights: Skills: Javascript · Python (Programming Language) · Lua · Regression Testing

positions.title: Drop-Off Center Windows Lead Tech
positions.description: Repaired personal computers with varying degrees of software and hardware problems. Performed routine checkups and optimizations as well as more involved repairs involving teardowns or parts transplants.

positions.title: Helpdesk Respondent
positions.description: Provided technical support for general-use software, as well as specialized or local campus software for clients of varying expertise over a range of media, including over phone, and in person. Often condensed technical information into digestible summaries for non-technical clients.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Developed a prototype social media application for Android and iOS using Apache Cordova. Implemented authentication and data retention through AWS, and utilized Google's Places API as well as hardware APIs.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed an automated system for data collection and digestion by calling APIs provided by government agencies like USGS. Deployed the system on AWS and parallelized the workflow through batch processing and asynchronous computation.
